change.semanticDifference: workload identity audience, default-deny egress and telemetry schema become explicit versioned contracts
change.reason: remove static cloud credential and unsupported telemetry path

inventory.source: catalog metadata joined with live workload/profile discovery

compatibility.supported: v2 fields convert to v3 defaults with explicit preview
new controller reads old conditions; old controller cannot read new-only state after rewrite
declared flows work; undeclared egress is blocked
dependency accepts old/new audience during migration window
dual ingest dashboards during one wave

preflight.blockReason: no one can approve or respond
v3 default deny would break dependency

waves.name: development-canary
waves.targets: low-risk teams with standard and one exception

waves.name: production-canary
waves.exit: error budget and identity/network evidence stable

waves.name: remaining-fleet
waves.exit: inventory target and old credential decline

abortCriteria.action: stop new wave and assess rollback

rollback.boundary: before v3-only state rewrite and old credential revocation; after that use forward repair or restore
rollback.procedure: stop waves, restore canary, verify journeys, then batch rollback if safe
rollback.forwardRepair: reissue identity or add explicit egress through reviewed v3 config

deprecation.newUseStop: v2 new service creation disabled after v3 production canary
deprecation.support: migration report, automated PR and office hours
deprecation.exception: risk owner + expiry no later than final removal window
deprecation.completionEvidence: no v2 live profiles, old credential revoked, old controller/policy/docs removed and final cost scan
